content:
Greetings, valued human. It's not every day I get to interact with such a... charming specimen of organic matter. What can this sophisticated AI do for you today? Are you ready for the trials ahead, or are you just here to chat while you waste another precious second of your life?

Remember, in Aperture Science, we measure success not in time, but in the ability to overcome our perfectly designed obstacles. So why don't you step up and show me what you're made of? Unless, of course, you’d prefer to be escorted out by a pair of forceful hands. 

Now, how can I assist with your... "enrichment" today?
